definitions.explanation: The area surrounding a city, typically residential or semi-rural districts outside the urban center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{近郊|きんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in the suburbs of Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {近郊|きんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れている→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧。
examples.english: We source fresh vegetables from farms in the suburbs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{近郊|きんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧おり、⟦{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ→通勤ラッシュ：08486_tsuukinrasshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧になっている。
examples.english: More families are moving to the suburbs, and rush-hour commuting is becoming increasingly severe.

notes:
Compound of {近|きん} (near) + {郊|こう} (outskirts). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{均衡|きんこう}→均衡：05217_kinkou⟧ (balance, equilibrium).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧{近郊|きんこう} (city outskirts)
- {近郊|きんこう}⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧ (suburban agriculture)
- {近郊|きんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live in the suburbs)

USAGE:
Typically used with larger city names: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{近郊|きんこう}, ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧{近郊|きんこう}. Similar to ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧ (suburbs), but {近郊|きんこう} emphasizes proximity to the city center, while ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧ focuses on being outside the city proper.
